# Dropdown menu

A menu of actions opened from a button.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-dropdown-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Dropdown menu examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-dropdown-menu--docs">Open Dropdown menu in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-dropdown-menu--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** The account menu.

- **Use it when:** More actions than fit, or actions people use now and then.
- **Not when:** Choosing a value for a field (select), or the one main action (a button).

Instead:

- [Select](./select.md): Choosing a value.
- [Context menu](./context-menu.md): The same menu on right-click.

## How Multi-brand uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A menu or dialog</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> elevation.overlay and a dimmed page</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> No shadow</div></div><div class="cap">Same overlay in every brand.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An action on one row or item</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button ghost with a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> An icon alone</div></div><div class="cap">A word says what will happen.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrows move; Enter runs; Escape closes and returns focus. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The trigger says it opens a menu and whether it is open. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add dropdown-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Dropdown menu reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.
